jobs.occupation: Expert (f/m/d) Gas Turbine Controls Commissioning (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Location: ERL S SK 3

Department: SE GS SO EC CO COS

Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management - ERA-Entgeltgruppe 12

Mode of Employment: Full-time / Permanent

A Snapshot of Your Day 

You apply your expertise on a daily basis to create value for Siemens Energy. A defined portion of your working time is dedicated to sharing and further developing your knowledge within your global expert community and beyond. This collaboration enables you to engage with colleagues and address challenges across organizational boundaries.

You demonstrate a strong passion for identifying technical solutions and business opportunities, contributing to Siemens Energy’s leadership in the global energy transition.

We are seeking a highly qualified expert to join the Commissioning Controls team, with a focus on establishing and strengthening commissioning back-office capabilities for gas turbine control systems. This position has been created to address evolving business needs and to manage the increasing technical complexity driven by new grid requirements, advanced fuel technologies (such as hydrogen), and stringent emission standards.

 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Act as an interface between commissioning, engineering, and project management to ensure efficient project execution within your area of expertise
* Lead and support prototype testing and first-time applications remotely and at construction sites worldwide, particularly for new or complex fuels (e.g., hydrogen co-firing, fuel oil) and stringent emissions compliance requirements
* Develop commissioning programs and support commissioning and engineering activities on site
* Serve as a consultant for grid requirements (certification, frequency control) from a commissioning perspective
* Support validation programs and assist task forces
* Support other organizations, such as R&D and new plant projects, within your area of expertise in internal and external working groups
* Take global responsibility for your discipline and drive continuous improvements, including collecting feedback from construction sites
* Develop, organize, and provide training for commissioning engineers in the field of Gas Turbine Governor Commissioning, and provide expert coaching and support both remotely and at construction sites worldwide
* Share and apply your expertise within the expert community

What You Bring

* Degree in Electrical Engineering as for example Automation, Electronics, Robotics or Control Engineering (BSc or MSc) and professional experience gained through several years of work in the field of Gas Turbine commissioning of Instrumentation, Control and Gas Turbine combustion process
* Knowledge of MS Office applications
* Business fluent German and fluent English
* Self-sufficient, independent, quality-oriented personality
* Team player mindset, excellent adaptability, very good communication skills.
* Driving license class B (Germany)

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural Validation (Statiker/in)
jobs.employer_name: GlassPoint Technology Center GmbH
jobs.description:
Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural Validation
Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Structural Engineer – Material Testing & Structural Validation, you'll play a key role in developing the lightweight structural systems that make GlassPoint's technology reliable, safe, and scalable.

Working closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams, you'll combine advanced engineering analysis with hands-on testing to validate innovative designs and ensure they perform under real-world conditions. From small-scale material characterization to full-scale component testing, your work will directly influence the next generation of technology.
 

Your Impact

The structures you validate will become part of some of the world's largest industrial solar thermal plants, helping heavy industry reduce emissions while improving energy security.

You'll combine engineering theory with practical experimentation, transforming test results into optimized designs and helping GlassPoint continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its technology.

What You'll Do

Design & Improve Structural Systems

- Analyze and optimize lightweight structural systems, components, and structural connections.
- Evaluate the behavior of steel, aluminum, composite materials, and ETFE film systems.
- Support the development of innovative structural concepts for industrial solar thermal applications.
- Transform engineering insights into scalable, manufacturable design improvements.

Lead Material & Component Testing

- Plan, build, execute, and evaluate material and component tests.
- Design and instrument full-scale structural testing.
- Conduct small-specimen material testing to characterize material behavior.
- Analyze test results and translate findings into engineering recommendations.

Develop & Validate Engineering Models

- Develop, calibrate, and improve nonlinear finite element (FEA) models.
- Predict structural behavior using numerical simulations.
- Validate simulation results through physical testing.
- Continuously refine engineering models to improve design accuracy.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams.
- Support design decisions through data-driven engineering.
- Contribute to solving complex structural challenges across international projects.
- Share technical expertise and help drive continuous innovation.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and turning analysis into practical solutions.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy moving between simulations, laboratory testing, and real-world engineering. You're curious, collaborative, and motivated by seeing your work become part of technologies that make a global impact.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (ideally with a background in construction, civil engineering, or automotive engineering).
- Several years of experience in structural, material, or component testing.
- Experience working with nonlinear material behavior and structural analysis.
- Strong experience with numerical modelling and nonlinear FEA.
- Hands-on experience planning and executing engineering tests.
- Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, and measurement systems.
- A structured, analytical, and independent working style.
- Confidence working in an international engineering environment.
- Excellent English communication skills; German is an advantage.
- Experience with foundation systems for solar structures, soil testing, rammed piles, ground screws, or percussion drilling is a plus.
What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.
 
We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.
 

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.

Job description

In order to support the Digital Payload Processors Design Team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) for Development of AI models for Spacecraft FDIR

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a AI Engineer for space systems?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in Digital Payload Processors as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn, near Munich
- Start: 01.10.2026
- Duration: min. 6 months, or longer

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

You will support the Digital Payload Processors Team to develop new, enhanced AI models for autonomous Fault Detection, Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) tasks.

- Exploration of AI architectures for best results in accordance with the input data.
- Performing trade off analysis of AI models based on key performance indices.
- Developing strategies to integrate AI models with other spacecraft subsystems.
- Exploration of methodologies and techniques on the path of efficient AI implementation chain.
- Implementation of tests to validate the AI models to ensure reliability and performance.
- Documentation of processes and results.
- Assist in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues related to development.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m), in a relevant degree program (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Communications Engineering, Aerospace Engineering).
- Strong knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and Neural Networks modeling frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch), preferably with experience in data engineering.
- Good signal processing background.
- Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Python, C/C++).
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and documentation skills.
- Fluent English is mandatory (written and spoken); German would be an asset.
- Experience of neural network inference on embedded processing platforms (CPU, FPGA) is a plus.
- Knowledge of spacecraft systems is a plus.
- You are a good team player, have excellent communication skills, and are able to work independently.

Job description

Master Thesis on Characterization of Sequence Robustness for Secure NTN Communications (d/f/m)

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a signal processing engineer for space systems? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the department Telecom & Navigation Processing as a Master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Taufkirchen / Ottobrunn, near Munich
- Start: 01.10.2026
- Duration: 6 months

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 35-hour week (flexitime).
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities, Scope of Master’s Thesis

6G / 5G is giving the convergence of terrestrial and satellite-based networks a major boost. Under the keyword "Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN)", satellites are being consistently integrated into the mobile communications standard for the first time, subsequently paving the way for a global and dense communication network in the future 6G generation.

Due to the inherent conditions of wireless communication – and particularly with the deployment of open standards and vast coverage areas – the threat posed by jammers and spoofers is ubiquitous. Specifically at the physical layer, the detection and suppression of malicious signals constitute an enormous challenge that must be overcome to ensure the integrity of the network.

The Master’s Thesis position will support the ongoing R&D activities on on-board implementation and scaling of a jamming robust gNodeB. The successful candidate shall contribute to one or more of the following fields:

- Sequence Analysis: Investigating the mathematical and statistical properties of different sequence designs in the context of NTN-specific channel conditions.
- Attack Modeling: Developing simulation models for various pilot-spoofing and jamming scenarios to evaluate their impact on signal integrity.
- Robustness Characterization: Analyzing how different sequence properties react to malicious interference through various performance metrics.
- Feature Identification: Identifying unique "signal signatures" or features that can be used to distinguish between legitimate and spoofed signals.
- Benchmark Development: Providing a comparative evaluation of sequence-based robustness to support the development of on-board detection algorithms.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled as a full-time student in Telecommunication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
- Strong foundation in Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and Communication Theory
- Proficiency in scripting and simulation using MATLAB or Python
- Basic understanding of OFDM waveforms
- Familiarity with communication standards (e.g., 3GPP, 6G/5G, or CCSDS) is a plus
- Excellent written and spoken English for technical documentation and communication; German is a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Join our team as Project Scheduler (f/m/d) for turnkey high-voltage substation projects within our Grid Technology Substations Germany organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the development, consolidation, and maintenance of integrated project schedules across all phases of project execution, from tendering through to commissioning.

You will work closely with cross-functional project teams, including engineering, procurement, construction, and project management, to ensure transparent, realistic, and achievable schedules. In addition, you will play a key role in defining, implementing, and continuously improving scheduling standards, tools, and methodologies across projects.

Given the complexity and scale of large infrastructure projects, the ideal candidate brings experience in project scheduling within the energy or plant engineering sector, preferably in high-voltage substations or comparable turnkey environments. While the main project focus is Germany, knowledge of international standards and best practices is a plus.

* Developing, maintaining, and controlling detailed project schedules for turnkey high-voltage substation projects across all project phases
* Integrating inputs from engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning into a consolidated, resource-loaded master schedule
* Monitoring project progress, identifying deviations, and proactively propose mitigation measures to ensure timely project execution
* Performing schedule risk analyses, scenario planning, and critical path assessments to support decision-making
* Establishing, harmonizing, and continuously improving scheduling standards, methods, and tools across projects and supporting tendering activities by preparing high-level schedules, milestones, and execution strategies
* Ensuring transparency through regular reporting, including progress updates, forecasts, and schedule KPIs for internal and external stakeholders as well as driving lessons learned and contributing to the continuous improvement of planning processes and governance

* Degree in engineering, project management, industrial engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent qualification combined with several years of relevant experience in project management and / or scheduling / planning
